description: This file defines the VanillaTilt class implementing a tilt effect for DOM elements, including gyroscope support, glare effects, and event handling. It also auto-initializes on elements with the data-tilt attribute.

classes.name: VanillaTilt
classes.description: Main class implementing tilt effects with options for glare, gyroscope, and full-page listening.

methods.name: extendSettings
methods.description: Merges user settings with default settings, reading data attributes if present.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Static method to initialize VanillaTilt on a set of elements.

methods.name: getElementListener
methods.description: Determines which DOM element will listen for mouse events.

methods.name: addEventListeners
methods.description: Attaches mouse, resize, and device orientation event listeners.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and resets the element.

methods.name: onDeviceOrientation
methods.description: Handles device orientation events for gyroscope tilt.

methods.name: onMouseEnter
methods.description: Handles mouse enter event, prepares for tilt.

methods.name: onMouseMove
methods.description: Handles mouse move event, updates tilt accordingly.

methods.name: onMouseLeave
methods.description: Handles mouse leave event, resets tilt.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Calculates tilt values and applies CSS transforms.

methods.name: prepareGlare
methods.description: Creates and styles glare elements if needed.

methods.name: updateGlareSize
methods.description: Adjusts glare element size based on target element.

methods.name: updateInitialPosition
methods.description: Sets initial tilt position based on settings.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Calculates tilt angles and percentages based on current event.
